content.text:
I opened **#69** to upgrade pit to **v0.36.2** and merged it once CI passed (squash, commit f1e62e3). Comment `@pi` here again to retest.

The new version makes `workspace.viewImage` work on pi-durable hosts, which fixes cv/pit#365. Its changelog also says images returned by nested `tools.*` calls now reach the model, including from tools that declare an output schema.

**What #69 changes:** `github:cv/pit#v0.36.1` becomes `#v0.36.2` in `.github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml` and in the two examples in `docs/extensions.md`. Nothing else changes.

This run still loaded pit v0.36.1, so I couldn't test the fix here. On the next run, a `viewImage` on the screenshot in this issue should attach the image, and I should be able to describe it.

pi-action still doesn't pass the new `images` option to pit, which would let it resize and convert images to fit the model's limits. Without it, PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP files under the size limit go to the model unchanged, which is enough for this screenshot. If the retest works, I can make a follow-up PR that passes `createNodePhotonImages()` in `src/durable-extensions.ts` so large screenshots get resized instead of rejected.
